summary: Iter11 — Frontend E2E for Maker Self-Serve Listings (Option B) PASSED 8/8 steps end-to-end against https://active-project-4.preview.emergentagent.com/maker/dashboard. JWT injected via add_init_script for maker iron-and-oak. Verified: (1) /maker/dashboard renders [data-testid='maker-dashboard'] without compile error after Field→LabeledField rename; (2) tab-products opens products-list with new-listing-btn visible; (3) clicking new-listing-btn opens new-listing-modal with all 13 expected fields present (title/price/category/technique/stock/dimensions/description/materials/model-url/dropzone/file-input/cancel/submit); (4) HTML5 canvas base64 compression — 1px PNG via set_input_files produced exactly 1 thumbnail in new-listing-image-grid within 2s; (5) POST /api/maker/products → 200 returning {id, slug:'test-listing-iter11', title:'TEST_listing_iter11', price:199, category:'Wall Art', technique:'PLASMA',...}, modal closed, listing appears in live products-list immediately; (6) DELETE /api/maker/products/test-listing-iter11 → 200, listing moved to ARCHIVED section (visible on screenshot with red badge), product-restore-{slug} button rendered, product-toggle-edit-{slug} gone; (7) POST /api/maker/products/test-listing-iter11/restore → 200, listing returns to live section, restore-btn removed, edit/delete buttons restored; (8) cleanup re-delete → 200 leaves test listing archived. window.confirm() dialog auto-handled via page.on('dialog', accept).
critical_code_review_comments: MakerDashboard.jsx ProductEditCard onDelete uses native window.confirm() (line 390). This blocks Playwright test runs unless dialogs are auto-accepted (page.on('dialog', d.accept())) and is jarring UX vs the rest of the polished marketplace. Recommend replacing with a styled inline confirm overlay (or a small confirmation toast with Undo) consistent with the brand. Not a defect — works correctly — but a UX/accessibility upgrade.

ProductEditCard archived/restore card has no data-testid='product-archived-{slug}' wrapper — testers currently disambiguate archived state by absence of edit-button or presence of restore-button. Adding data-testid='product-archived-{p.slug}' on the parent <div> when p.deleted_at would simplify selectors.

NewListingModal image-grid (data-testid='new-listing-image-grid') children tags lack per-thumb data-testid (e.g., new-listing-thumb-0). Currently testers count elements inside the grid; per-index testids would let assertions verify specific upload positions.

Iter8 transfer_group mismatch in /app/backend/routers/stripe_connect.py (Transfer.create uses session_id, PaymentIntent uses pre_transfer_group uuid) — STILL re-flagged from iter7/8/10. Separate-charge-and-transfer in production will fail. Not in scope of iter11 but persists across iterations.
